subject.title: chore(deps): bump the production-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 22 updates

question: Should this grouped 22-package production dependency update land as one PR, or should the runtime/native/API-sensitive updates be split before merge?
rationale: The diff is mechanically clean and green, but it changes production runtime packages across several surfaces, so automation cannot decide the acceptable upgrade blast radius.

options.title: Accept grouped update
options.body: Merge if maintainers are comfortable owning the combined production dependency compatibility risk on the green CI and preview evidence.

options.title: Split sensitive packages
options.body: Ask for Convex, TanStack, sharp, Resend/email, and markdown-rendering packages to be reviewed in smaller batches before merge.

options.title: Wait for a later batch
options.body: Close or pause this Dependabot batch if maintainers prefer a fresher regenerated update set.

recommendation.title: Accept grouped update
recommendation.body: Merge if maintainers are comfortable owning the combined production dependency compatibility risk on the green CI and preview evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the clearest current package-manifest history owner for this dependency baseline.
